additional_mathematical_passages.claim: The explicit rank-one noncommuting inflation matrices give a cited inflation expression of 2 but an admissible zero-flux path of action 4-2 sqrt(2)<2; for entrywise divergence this is the exact Bures minimum.
derivation: e=(1,0), v=(1,1)/sqrt(2), P0=ee^T and P1=vv^T are noncommuting rank-one projections; 2 tr((P1-P0)^2)=2.
For w=v-e and u_s=e+s w, |u_s|^2=1-(2-sqrt(2))s(1-s)>0, and d_s(u_s u_s^T)=sym(2 u_s w^T).
At zero flux and H=I, saturation of the mass-dual constraint reduces the local support to sup_y(2 w dot y-|y|^2/2)=2|w|^2=4-2 sqrt(2), since C^T u_s ranges over R^2.
The time interval has length one and the spatial measure is a unit Dirac mass. The entrywise space-constant Bures certificate supplies the matching lower bound.
